visual_identity.uniform: navy professional security uniform, yellow high-visibility reflective vest, radio, safety footwear; site-specific hardhat
visual_identity.exclude: police uniform, generic road worker substituted for security operative, static filler shots

rules: Preserve Arabic narration as source timing; do not rewrite without owner agreement
One narrated action equals one demonstrable physical scene; avoid generic establishing fillers
Use identical recognizable marshal actor and appropriate licensed location
No invented regulatory compliance or generic hand signals portrayed as standard
Verify per-clip commercial license and source provenance
All files review-only until safety, mobile playback and visual signoff

screens.visual_prompt_en: At an industrial security gate the same PRIVATE SECURITY traffic marshal wearing navy security uniform, yellow high-visibility vest, radio and safe footwear, demonstrates identifying pedestrian crossing, maintaining emergency lane and radio coordination; vehicles respond only when directed safely.
screens.visual_acceptance: marshal at protected site entry, clear pedestrian crossing and operational radio; not generic worker or policeman

screens.visual_prompt_en: Private security traffic marshal and security supervisor review a readable site Traffic Management Plan on a clipboard in a safe office; cut to the marshal tracing authorized gate entry, pedestrian route, blind spot and emergency escape route while pointing at real physical signs.
screens.visual_acceptance: TMP being reviewed on screen then confirmed in real site; no unrelated highway establishing shots

screens.visual_prompt_en: Private security traffic marshal at a controlled entrance communicates with access-control colleague using radio; incoming vehicle stops at marked checkpoint, guard checks clearance, driver moves forward only after explicit safe release, emergency lane remains clear.
screens.visual_acceptance: vehicle response, gate inspection and marshal coordination visible

screens.visual_prompt_en: Driver's vehicle is safely parked in briefing bay; uniformed private security traffic marshal explains site speed limit and authorized loading route, driver acknowledges; for refusal the marshal calmly reports to supervisor via radio instead of arguing in traffic.
screens.visual_acceptance: respectful driver briefing and safe escalation visibly performed

screens.visual_prompt_en: Uniformed private security marshal stands outside vehicle path at a protected pedestrian crossing; ensures approaching site vehicle is fully stationary; pedestrian and wheelchair user cross protected route; only then controlled safe release of vehicles.
screens.visual_acceptance: protected pedestrian crossing and real vehicle response required

screens.visual_prompt_en: Security marshal coordinates accessible parking, loading bay and cone layout; controlled reversing manoeuvre filmed only after qualified trainer signs off, guide stays visible outside reversing path and driver stops when eye contact lost.
screens.visual_acceptance: for reversing demonstration, hold release until site-specific instructor approval; contextual footage alone cannot pass

screens.visual_prompt_en: Private security marshal checks reflective vest, boots and weather protection, drinks water under shade during authorised break, points to safe escape route; radio coordination clears emergency access before an ambulance approaches.
screens.visual_acceptance: hazard action PPE heat stress and emergency lane must match corresponding audio

screens.visual_prompt_en: Security marshal at safe post records accurate observed time, vehicle description, location and direction in incident report; radios control room; no unverified accusation, no scene contamination.
screens.visual_acceptance: show writing actual report and verbal report, not just generic notebook

screens.visual_prompt_en: One consistent trained private security marshal performs six distinct site-approved traffic signals with front three-quarter and side views, visible compliant driver response; movement is slow, fully human and continuous.
screens.visual_acceptance: UNAPPROVED unless verified against target site's official signals by qualified instructor; no improvised AI hand gestures

screens.visual_prompt_en: Uniformed traffic marshal demonstrates concise radio call and acknowledgment with control room; presents lane status and route hazards to incoming relief marshal, hands over log and radio at approved safe post.
screens.visual_acceptance: show call acknowledgment, log handover and second uniformed marshal
